title: PRIV-002 Consent Persistence Contract
semanticRules: A registration consent record is durable and is created in the same authoritative registration transaction as the protected User write.
AUTH-001 registration creates consent with purpose ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION, legalBasis CONSENT and initial state GRANTED.
The policyVersion attached to a consent record is immutable.
actorSubjectId and ownerSubjectId resolve to the newly committed ENT-USER.id for AUTH-001 registration.
resourceId resolves to the protected ENT-USER.id and resourceType is User for AUTH-001 registration.
duplicate consent submission for the same registration request is deterministic and does not create a second consent record.
withdrawal changes state to REVOKED, records withdrawnAt once, preserves immutable history and emits the admitted withdrawal event.
RESTRICTED_PROCESSING is reserved for policy-controlled restriction and is not a client-selectable registration state.
retentionClass is server-selected and fixed to LEGAL_AUDIT for consent records.
retentionUntil is server-calculated from the applicable retention policy for the consent policyVersion and is not client-selectable.
legalHoldRef is nullable and may block purge under the global lifecycle contract.
consent records are never the source of authentication credentials or account state.
nonAuthorizations: No physical table or collection name is fixed here.
No migration is authorized by this contract.
No runtime implementation is authorized by this contract.
No public consent-management API is introduced by this contract.
